scientific_integrity: Every one of the \(2^{20}\) subsets is checked against the explicit ordinary location-domination predicate by two independent implementations. The full coefficient vectors are asserted and re-executed. Independent scholarly audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite result for the two stated twenty-vertex cubic graphs only; it relies on complete enumeration and makes no infinite-family claim. Unindexed earlier equivalents remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact locating-domination reliability dominance for two cubic 20-vertex graphs
